name: iDonatio
shortDescription: A UK donation and Gift Aid service for charities. It covers online donations and donations by plate or envelope.
suitableContexts: Churches needing online donations alongside Gift Aid claims
Churches recording eligible digital, plate or envelope donations
Charities that want donor Gift Aid preferences and claims administered in one platform

pricing.summary: iDonatio publishes free organisation registration and a 5.75% + £0.30 transaction fee per donation. It offers an option for donors to cover that fee. Its terms say some transaction charges vary by card and that Stripe-connected accounts can carry gateway charges.

tiers.label: iDonatio giving platform
tiers.detail: Published fee; donor can elect to cover it

pricing.trialDetails: No general free trial was found in the public material reviewed.

gdprInformation: iDonatio publishes donor and donee privacy policies and terms. Its donor policy states Gift Aid declarations and donation records are retained for the legally specified periods described there; churches should read the applicable current policy and agree how donor data will be used.
coreFeatures: Direct HMRC Gift Aid claim submission
importExport: Donor-facing donation-history download described by the supplier

data-processing.value: Supplier publishes privacy policy material covering donor data, Gift Aid data sharing and stated retention periods.

hmrc-claiming.value: iDonatio UK Ltd is included in HMRC's current commercial-supplier list for iGACOS.

fees.value: Supplier publishes a 5.75% + £0.30 transaction fee and free organisation registration.

editorial.assessment: iDonatio is a UK donation and Gift Aid platform rather than a full church-management system. It may suit churches that want a donor-facing digital giving option with Gift Aid, GASDS and paper-donation workflows in one service. Its published transaction fee is materially higher than some alternatives, so a church should model it against donation patterns and donor-fee choice before adoption.
bestFor: Churches wanting Gift Aid-enabled online donations and a related donor app
Teams needing to bring plate, envelope and digital Gift Aid administration together
Charities prepared to evaluate a per-donation fee model
strengths: Active UK company and current HMRC commercial-software listing
Published transaction fee and donor-pays-fee option
Supplier describes Gift Aid, GASDS, digital declarations and audit trails
limitations: It is not a complete people, rota or church-website platform
Transaction and gateway costs need realistic scenario modelling
Read the applicable data, deletion, Gift Aid and Stripe terms before importing donor records

procurementVerdict.problem: Gift Aid information and donations spread across digital and paper workflows
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Donation collection, digital declarations and HMRC claim submission in a UK product
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Model donation fees and test a digital, envelope and Gift Aid claim journey with the finance team
